Abstract
We propose a quantum version of a generative diffusion model. In this algorithm, artificial
neural networks are replaced with parameterized quantum circuits, in order to directly gen-
erate quantum states. We present both a full quantum and a latent quantum version of the
algorithm; we also present a conditioned version of these models. The models’ performances
have been evaluated using quantitative metrics complemented by qualitative assessments. An
